'''First aid specialist''', sometimes abbreviated '''FAS''', was a rank in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The people with this title were specialized in healing injures in the middle of a battle. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Coric]] was a first aid specialist.
